body: Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #276 (round-0 heads 7aa565a7/aceb1b14; round-1 heads 3363ed7a/6ce4e3b3; round-2 final head aa556845). Product diff read in full: mask_home_paths appended to mask_secret_matches (shared with the gate's masked feedback comparison), a machine-independent home-path pattern (/home|/Users accounts incl. leading underscore, root homes ~, ~, ~ bare or <home>/.<dir>, namespace-root boundary (?<=~), repository home/ entries excluded, running $HOME anywhere when multi-segment), the .orchestration scan over raw text and decoded JSON strings, gitignored-path skipping via one cached git ls-files call with os.fsdecode, byte-preserving --mask-secrets, and tests for each (109 lines) plus a real-validator task-audit test in test_herdr_agents. Independent replay of the mechanical re-mask: origin/main's 749 tracked .orchestration files restored into a checkout of aceb1b14 and masked with the PR's own validator reproduce the PR's files with zero differences (a first replay from a scratch copy diverged only because the validator derives its repository root from its own location, which also shows the home/-entry exclusion is load-bearing: the T75 audit transcript quotes ${REPO_ROOT}/home/dot_config/...). No -pr-feedback.json changed. Nine Bot threads: eight fixes verified in the final pattern code (2ae3e52c, dae71adc, 81812b72 x2, e515beb1 x3, 7aa565a7); the ninth (accounts named like a top-level home/ entry, on the update-branch head) dispositioned not-applicable with the exclusion's purpose recorded as a design limit. CI 13/13 on aceb1b14; the e515beb1 macOS failure (APFS refuses a non-UTF-8 fixture name) was fixed in beb6c763. Rule left unedited at 429/450 words; SKILL Stop checklist and boundary bullet name the masker.

Round 1 (d6b93ea9, 3363ed7a): the scan shares the masker's pattern and adds the running user's multi-segment $HOME as a machine-dependent backstop (one-segment keeps the boundary); ~ and ~ match any child while plain ~ keeps the bare-or-.<dir> restriction and a $HOME of ~ adds no alternative, so committed Codex sub-agent ids survive; account components are any Unicode word character; /var/home and /export/home are machine-independent roots. Replay from a checkout of 6ce4e3b3 over origin/main's 749 evidence files reproduces the PR byte for byte, so the widened pattern changes no tracked evidence (worker: re-mask run twice, 0 changes). Report distinguishes the eight fixed round-0 Bot findings from the home/-entry design limit; the narrated grep count was replaced by verbatim output re-run on the discarded commit f3181a63. Round-1 Bot threads: two fixed in 3363ed7a (Unicode accounts, root sub-agent ids), one dispositioned not-applicable (arbitrary custom home roots unknowable to CI; portable relocations added). PONG decision 1 (cap the pattern) was dispatched 07:51Z and had not been read when the RESULT was sent; the RESULT's own proposed not-applicable matches it. CI 13/13 on 6ce4e3b3; no Bot review on the update-branch head.

Round 2 (aa556845): mask_secrets decides JSON handling by parse success exactly as the scan's json_strings does, independent of the file suffix (ValueError and RecursionError caught), with a test that a .md file whose whole content is JSON with escaped slashes is masked and then passes the scan; the sandbox record now covers the round-1 scratch worktree (git worktree remove only). The Codex review-body finding 5411302667 (on d6b93ea9) is dispositioned fixed:aa556845 in the report and in the sweep; the orchestrator's sweep now reads review bodies for P-badge findings instead of treating every review item as a container. Re-mask after aa556845: 0 changes (orchestrator replay at aa556845 reproduces the 749 re-masked files byte for byte). Bot coverage: quota notices at 07:39Z, 08:04Z and 08:24Z mean the Bot reviewed neither 3363ed7a, 6ce4e3b3 nor aa556845; the task-level audit is the independent review of the final head. CI 13/13 on aa556845; main unmoved (94409ec4).
